snippet.title: Bolariki Match3 Rogue-like | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4733580/Bolariki/
The match-3 roguelike. Stack relics, shatter rules, and pull off outrageous combos, all inside a puzzle game that boots like a fever dream from 1995. Crunchy, retro, and dangerously easy to start. Impossible to stop.
